facts.text: The resort is in North Male Atoll, 25 minutes by speedboat from Velana International Airport.
facts.excerpt: an award-winning luxury Maldives island resort in North Male Atoll, just 25 minutes by speedboat from Velana International Airport

facts.text: The island is encircled by a house reef just steps from the shore.
facts.excerpt: Encircled by a vibrant house reef just steps from the shore

facts.text: Every villa is a beach villa with its own private pool.
facts.excerpt: the resort offers 48 private all-pool beach villas designed for intimacy, wellbeing, and connection with nature

facts.text: Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru was founded in 1995 and is one of the pioneers of luxury hospitality in the Maldives.
facts.excerpt: Founded in 1995, Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru is one of the pioneers of luxury hospitality in the Maldives

facts.text: The resort's Marine Lab, established in 2004, is one of the Maldives' first resort-based marine conservation centres, working on coral restoration, reef monitoring and marine education.
facts.excerpt: Established in 2004, Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru’s Marine Lab is one of the Maldives’ first resort-based marine conservation centres, pioneering coral restoration, reef monitoring, and marine education

facts.text: Guests can step from the beach into the water, where coral gardens and marine life begin just moments from shore.
facts.excerpt: guests can step from the beach into crystal-clear waters, where coral gardens and marine life begin just moments from shore

facts.text: A PADI dive centre offers dives on the house reef, the nearby Rannamaari shipwreck and surrounding dive sites, plus PADI courses.
facts.excerpt: With a PADI dive centre, you can explore the vibrant house reef, discover the nearby Rannamaari shipwreck – resting since 1999 – or explore over 40 surrounding dive sites. PADI courses are available

facts.text: Banyan Tree Spa was the first international spa in the Maldives, with therapists trained for over 600 hours at the Banyan Tree Spa & Wellbeing Academy.
facts.excerpt: Banyan Tree Spa, the first international spa in the Maldives, offers intuitive, holistic treatments rooted in centuries of Asian healing wisdom, guided by therapists trained for over 600 hours

facts.text: Resident Wellbeing Practitioner Dr. Sharma, with a background in Naturopathy and Clinical Acupuncture, offers acupuncture, cupping and sound healing.
facts.excerpt: With a medical background in Naturopathy and a specialisation in Clinical Acupuncture, his approach is intuitive and restorative.

facts.text: Wellbeing experiences include private yoga, breathwork, Lagoon Floating Therapy and sound baths.
facts.excerpt: · Private Yoga · Breathwork · Lagoon Floating Therapy · Sound Bath

facts.text: The Grand Beachfront Pool Villa is the only villa type with a separate living room and sleeps up to five, with a private pool and direct beach access.
facts.excerpt: this is the only one of our five villa types with an extra separate living room — which is what takes it from sleeping three to sleeping five

facts.text: In the Beachfront Pool Villa the private pool sits at the main door and the beach opens out at the backyard.
facts.excerpt: your private pool sits at the main door, and the beach opens out at the backyard. From there, it's a swim across the lagoon to the coral garden at the outer reef

facts.text: The Beachfront Sunset View Pool Villa has a private pool, jet pool, direct ocean access and sunset views over the Indian Ocean.
facts.excerpt: featuring a private pool, jet pool, direct ocean access and stunning sunset views over the Indian Ocean

facts.text: The Wellbeing Sanctuary Pool Villa has sleep-focused design, sustainable Maldivian interiors, a private pool and direct beach access.
facts.excerpt: A 120 sqm Maldives wellness villa with an immersive wellbeing experience, sleep-focused design, sustainable Maldivian interiors, a private pool and direct beach access

facts.text: The Oceanview Pool Villa is set back in its own secluded garden with Indian Ocean views from the pool deck.
facts.excerpt: A Maldives private villa set back in its own secluded garden, with panoramic views of the Indian Ocean from your pool deck.

facts.text: Madi Hiyaa is an overwater Japanese restaurant built entirely from bamboo.
facts.excerpt: Madi Hiyaa's sustainable architecture, meticulously crafted entirely from bamboo

facts.text: Madi Hiyaa was recognised by Prix Versailles 2024 as one of the World's Most Beautiful Restaurants.
facts.excerpt: has been recognised by Prix Versailles 2024 as one of the World’s Most Beautiful Restaurants

facts.text: Dining runs across four venues linked by a dine-around concept: Thai at Saffron, Japanese at Madi Hiyaa, Sangu Garden and the beachfront Naiboli Bar.
facts.excerpt: Dining in Maldives at Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru runs across four venues, linked by an exclusive dine-around concept

facts.text: Water activities include kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, catamaran sailing, windsurfing, jet skiing and dolphin cruises.
facts.excerpt: house reef snorkeling, scuba diving, kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, catamaran sailing, windsurfing, jet skiing, dolphin cruises, and private charter excursions

facts.text: Destination dining includes a beach barbecue, a floating breakfast in the villa pool, a private sala deck dinner and a romantic beach dinner.
facts.excerpt: Awaken to a lavish floating breakfast in the Maldives, embraced by the intimacy of your secluded private pool.

facts.text: All destination dining experiences are subject to weather conditions and seasonality.
facts.excerpt: All Maldives destination dining experiences are subject to weather conditions and seasonality.

facts.text: The island can be exclusively reserved for private celebrations and special occasions.
facts.excerpt: The island may also be exclusively reserved for private celebrations and special occasions.

facts.text: Guests can join a hands-on Maldivian cooking class in an open-air kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Join us in our open-air kitchen, surrounded by the tropical beauty of the Maldives, as our expert chefs guide you through the secrets of Maldivian cuisine.

facts.text: With only 48 villas the resort is intimate and secluded.
facts.excerpt: As an intimate Maldives island resort with only 48 villas, guests enjoy a secluded, tranquil setting

facts.text: Madi Hiyaa described as the best Japanese cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Madi Hiyaa, the Best Japanese cuisine
